analysis.headline: ETF Rotation Analysis: Energy and Tech Themes Lead While Discretionary and Industrials Broadly Deteriorate
analysis.market_regime: Selective Rotation Market with Sub-Industry Concentration and Material Sector Divergences
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative evidence indicates strong persistent relative leadership in Energy (XLE, XOP, IXC) and Latin America (EWZ, ILF), complemented by accelerating technology themes in Cybersecurity (CIBR) and Software (IGV). Conversely, Consumer Discretionary (XLY, XHB) and Industrials (XLI, ITA) remain locked in rotation-out conditions or 63-bar score lows. Internal sector divergences are pronounced within Health Care (IHF vs XPH) and Real Estate (REZ vs REM), while style factors show pending raw transitions.

cross_market_confirmations: Energy strength is broad and mutually confirmed across domestic exploration (XOP score 92.92, PERSISTENT_LEADER), U.S. broad energy (XLE score 94.09, PERSISTENT_LEADER), and global energy (IXC score 83.12, PERSISTENT_LEADER, rs20 +2.54, rs63 +14.56).

Deterioration in European developed markets is confirmed across Eurozone blue chips (FEZ score 29.38, 63-bar score low), France (EWQ score 30.41), and broad Europe (VGK score 50.63, score_change_20 -23.12).
risks_or_conflicts: Sector Divergence in Health Care: Sub-industry provider ETF IHF shows strong relative improvement with a 20-bar score change of +17.29 (confirmed state EMERGING), whereas pharmaceutical ETF XPH deteriorates severely with a 20-bar score change of -50.76 (confirmed state WEAKENING, 63-bar score low of 36.46), alongside weak performance in medical devices ETF IHI (WEAKENING, score 37.50).

Sector Divergence in Real Estate: Residential ETF REZ exhibits short-term relative improvement with a 20-bar score change of +30.37 (confirmed state NEUTRAL), whereas mortgage real estate ETF REM declines with a 20-bar score change of -23.63 (confirmed state NEUTRAL, raw state WEAKENING pending 2/3 days), alongside weakening broad real estate ETF XLRE (score 45.00).

Pair State Tension in Style Factors: Large-cap value ETF IWD holds a confirmed WEAKENING state with a 5-bar score change of -23.89 and 20-bar score change of -47.32, yet retains a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal versus paired ticker IWF due to its 63-bar spread (+4.70 pct points). Short-term spreads have turned negative (pair_spread_20 of -1.92 pct points), creating a pending raw PAIR_MIXED relationship (1/3 days).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
